description:
Fotografer corporate kelas satu dan kelas dua menggunakan peralatan yang sama. Yang membedakan keduanya bukan kamera.

Tier-1 datang ke setiap event dengan sistem kerja. Mereka punya shot list yang dibangun dari brief, bukan dari kebiasaan. Mereka tahu nama VIP sebelum event mulai. Mereka sudah memetakan risiko teknis dari denah venue.

Tier-2 datang dengan kamera bagus dan harapan bahwa hari ini akan berjalan lancar.

Hasilnya terlihat dari 30 foto pertama. Selalu.

Apa yang paling membedakan fotografer corporate terbaik yang pernah kamu hire dari yang mengecewakan?

---

The gap between a tier-1 and tier-2 corporate photographer is not the equipment. It is the system they bring to the job.

Tier-1 arrives with a shot list built from the brief, not from habit. They know the VIP names before doors open. They have mapped the technical risks from the venue floor plan.

Tier-2 arrives with a good camera and the hope that the day will go smoothly.

The difference shows up in the first 30 images. Every time.

What has been the biggest difference between the best corporate photographer you have hired and one who fell short?

Planning a corporate event? If you need photo/video with clear delivery standards and fast turnaround, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
